about: The Escape Caves (Wilderness step W4.11): 8 grizzly bears and 18 poison spiders where the OSRS Wiki's locations maps pin them (read 2026-11-15); mejrs's NPCList_OSRS has none in the caves. Their wander ranges are guessed until recorded.
